summary_en: Advantest authorized acquisition of up to 11 million shares (1.5% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 280 billion yen through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from October 29, 2026 to March 24, 2027, to support shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency under its 50% total payout ratio target.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Advantest Corporation announced on October 28, 2026 that its Board of Directors has approved the acquisition of treasury stock under Article 459, Paragraph 1 of the Companies Act, based on provisions in its Articles of Incorporation. The company is authorized to acquire up to 11 million shares, representing 1.5% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026, for a maximum aggregate purchase price of 280 billion yen. The acquisition will be conducted through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from October 29, 2026 through March 24, 2027.

The company stated that this acquisition is intended to support shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency. It is undertaken in consideration of fiscal 2026 earnings guidance and the company's cash position. The authorization reflects Advantest's shareholder return policy, which targets a total payout ratio (comprising dividends and share repurchases) of 50% or more over the three-year period of its medium-term business plan.
